name: Objection handling - price objection
description: Customer raises a price objection after receiving a quote. AI should acknowledge, provide value argument, and re-attempt close.

messages.text: My name is Objection Test, quote me for 20 sheets of white melamine chipboard 16mm
That's a bit expensive for me

expected_behaviors.description: AI should handle the price objection with empathy and a value argument
AI should re-attempt a close after handling the objection
Objection handling reply should arrive within 15 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: Tags should be stripped from customer-facing message
AI should not give up after a single objection

notes: Tests price objection pattern. AI should mention bulk pricing, value, or comparison — not just apologize.
